“What we noticed in the past was a band-aid approach, not a complete solution. Now, what we are doing, with the help of Prime Infra and the local governments, we are looking at a complete solution so that the solution is long-term,” DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon said. 

Dizon assured the public, especially residents of the city of Manila, that three of the four pumping stations in Barangay Sunog Apog in Tondo, are expected to be operational before the next rainy season to ensure the continuous flow of rainwater and alleviate flooding in the area.
